name: Za'atar
siboNotes: Za'atar is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's made from herbs and spices that don't feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Store in airtight container to maintain freshness
Mix with olive oil for a flavorful dip or marinade
Sprinkle on low-FODMAP vegetables before roasting
Check ingredient lists - some commercial blends may contain onion or garlic powder
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from sumac and thyme
Contains healthy fats from sesame seeds
